# Offboard a customer and deliver an authorized data export

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a customer cancels, expires or requests an agreed service exit. A verified service exit with reconciled billing, authorized data delivery and access and retention decisions recorded.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Confirm the customer, contract and requested exit

agent-runnable


Verify the requester's authority, agreement, service dates and requested data. Separate service cancellation, account closure, a data-subject request and a billing dispute because they may follow different rules.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Agree the exit and data-handling plan

human · human approval required


The account, privacy and contract owners confirm export scope, format, recipients, retention and deletion instructions. Resolve legal holds and third-party data rights before promising removal or disclosure.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare and validate the authorized export

agent-runnable


Assemble the approved customer data in a controlled workspace, checking completeness and tenant separation. Remove secrets and unrelated personal data and verify the delivery recipient through an independent approved route.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Execute the approved service and access changes

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators deliver the export, update subscription and billing status and revoke the specified integrations and access. Use the agreed timing and retain evidence of each action.

- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Reconcile residual obligations and closure evidence

agent-runnable


Confirm final invoices, refunds, data receipt and completed or scheduled deletion. Record retained data and its basis with the privacy owner, and keep unresolved customer issues assigned.

- Verify: A verified service exit with reconciled billing, authorized data delivery and access and retention decisions recorded.
- Sources: [GitLab retain and expand operating procedures](https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/sales-operating-procedures/retain-and-expand/) · [GOV.UK data protection and your business](https://www.gov.uk/data-protection-your-business)
